svg.title: Exponential waiting time: PDF and CDF

cc:Work.dc:title: Exponential waiting time: PDF and CDF
cc:Work.dc:description: Calculated exponential density and CDF with rate 0.2 per minute. The probability of waiting at most five minutes is 1-exp(-1)=0.6321.
